extracted.name: Cilok (savoury tapioca balls)
extracted.description: Hey, this dish is yummy and easy to make. As long as you can find the ingredients😀 #superbowl
instruction_lines: Mix all together till it form like a glue, and add little by little egg and tapioca.
Boil in hot water, until it comes up floating.
Enjoy warm or cold with sweet soy sauce and sriracha sauce sambal
